get_source_lines_and_file_fn: get source lines, file line number, and filename for a Python function object
normalize_source_lines_list: normalize indentation of source lines so all lines align to the function definition indent level
parse_def_function: parse a Python function into an AST with a SourceContext including source, filename, and leading whitespace
create_SourceContext: create a SourceContext object to store source, filename, line number, and metadata for TorchScript compilation
make_source_context_cached: create a cached SourceContext instance from source, filename, line number, and leading whitespace parameters
